security_decisions: VibeFlow Control Plane remains authoritative for VibeFlow resources; provider/client claims are observations or requests.
External content from agent/model/tool/workspace/repository/provider/web is untrusted data when it crosses into authority decisions.
All privileged actions are server-bound to authenticated actor plus canonical tenant/project/resource/binding/grant/policy/approval context.
Plaintext secrets are confined to approved broker/KMS custody and minimum authorized runtime channel; never ordinary client/prompt/event/evidence/log/analytics/bridge state.
High-risk/irreversible actions preserve policy/evidence semantics, fresh approval where required, and idempotency/deduplication.
Agent/provider completion never directly becomes VERIFIED; verification binds independent evidence where feasible to exact revision/check.
Workspace/repository/provider mutable state is reconciled before verification/release claims.
Ambiguous identity/scope/binding/freshness/continuity/approval/evidence fails closed or enters explicit reconciliation.
Provider-specific behavior stays behind adapters; no provider can silently weaken core authority.
No new cryptography/security protocol is invented; approved standards/libraries/providers remain the implementation path.
